Hey All,

Wondering what you use to help manager your characters? Do you have a different notebook for each one or are you more tech inclined using a PC with Onenote/Evernote, something else I haven't heard of? List the pros and cons if possible too!

So what tools or devices do you use?

Thanks,
Character Management; Tools of the Trade

I moved from Pen and Paper to Excel spreadsheets, while i didn't have any macros it was pretty easy to use and find stuff. But as the game got more complex so did our characters and I eventually moved everything into Onenote. Its really nice with PC with screen clippings from the PDFs out there. Really helps to keep everything cleanly organized and search able.

The majority of the time i just use a text document, type up the relevant stats, and change as needed. I used pencil and paer for a bit when I started, but my handwriting is horrendous enough that I only do so upon request now. besides, data lasts longer and is more easily changeable than paper.

I'm still 100% on paper. I've been considering going digital for a while, but just haven't done it. My handwriting is small and neat, so I don't have too much issue with just writing things. It's mainly just wearing through the paper where I've erased things a lot. I keep scratch paper for jotting things down (keeping track of arrows, quick quest notes, etc) and another person in our group keeps a notebook for any major details that we might need later on.

If there's a good iPad/tablet resource, I'd probably use it, but I haven't found a good app yet.

I'm all over the place ;)

Some of my sheets are on my google drive, others are on paper. I can't really decide which I like better so I'm sticking to may chaos for the time being. I would probably convert to an online app completely if one existed that had everything I needed. To-date I haven't found such an app, however.

I've actually switched to Google Sheets. The character sheets have areas that will autofill skills, abilities, weapons, weight, and health. I haven't had a chance to test it out yet, but I'm excited for when I do.
